WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    l.ID,
    p.SEX,
    AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) as col3,
    AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) as col4
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    SEX as col1,
    AVG(col3) as col2,
    AVG(col4) as col3
  FROM step1
  GROUP BY SEX
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT AVG(col3) as col1
  FROM step2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT 
    s2.col1,
    s2.col2,
    s2.col3,
    s2.col3 - s3.col1 as col4
  FROM step2 s2
  CROSS JOIN step3 s3
  WHERE s2.col3 IS NOT NULL AND s3.col1 IS NOT NULL AND s2.col3 > s3.col1
)
SELECT 
  AVG(col2) as result1,
  AVG(col3) as result2,
  AVG(col4) as result3
FROM step4
